title: Drawing on the Powers of Heaven: Spiritual Gifts and Pleading Your Case
summary: This lengthy Sabbath day message reviews the crucial role of spiritual gifts—including discernment, power of recall, and charity—in augmenting human capability. Drawing on teachings from Brigham Young and modern apostles, the text explains that gifts must be actively requested and cultivated. Additionally, it highlights the scriptural pattern of 'pleading your case' specifically and boldly before God, using Helaman's Nephi as a prime example of reasoning with the Lord rather than defaulting to vague, general prayers.
